title: Fear Effect
synopsis: Kronos’ 2000 PlayStation cel-shaded thriller, ported for the first time — retained as Limited Run Games’ #285 Nintendo Switch physical edition.

catalog.developer: Kronos Digital Entertainment · Nintendo Switch port by Implicit Conversions
catalog.publisher: Limited Run Games with Square Enix · originally Eidos Interactive
catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · Limited Run Games edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case · Limited Run Games #285 edition

curatorNotes:
Fear Effect is Kronos Digital Entertainment’s 2000 PlayStation action-adventure: cel-shaded mercenaries Hana, Glas, and Deke chase a Triad boss’s runaway daughter through full-motion-video backgrounds into the supernatural. Eidos published the original.

Implicit Conversions ported it to modern platforms, its first release outside the original PlayStation, and it appeared on the Nintendo Switch eShop on August 29, 2025. Limited Run Games produced the physical edition as Switch Limited Run #285.

This filing opens the Fear Effect lineage on the shelf.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Switch Limited Run #285, Limited Run Games’ standard physical edition of Fear Effect.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: Original PlayStation release in 2000, published by Eidos Interactive. The modern port released on August 29, 2025; Limited Run Games issued the Switch physical edition (HAC-P-BMFBA) as Switch Limited Run #285 in standard, Deluxe, and event-exclusive cover editions.
preservation.availability: Limited Run Games’s physical edition was a limited production and now circulates through the secondary market. The digital Switch edition was issued separately on the Nintendo eShop.
